meta.where: No separate approval screen. Every category screen in Pre-production (char, loc, prop) has a 'Something wrong with this list?' button and a per-asset menu. Both open this catalog.
meta.flow: UI asks technical or preference, shows the reasons below, collects targets (tap the asset cards) and optional text, then sends fix_requests with mode 'fix' and previous_output. Several requests can be sent in one round.
meta.suggestion_after_max_rounds: Offer manual add, rename or delete (backend operations) instead of another dami round.
meta.voice_note: Voices are not reviewed here. They are handled in Production per text block (upload, generate, or let the video model create them).

rules.approved_assets: Requests that would rename, redescribe, merge away or delete an asset whose status is 'approved' make the UI ask for confirmation first, because generated images depend on it. Pre-production work already done on a merged-away asset is kept as a version but detached.
rules.ids: Ids never change except for ADT04 (new type, new id) and the removed side of ADT02 or ADT03. The backend rewrites every reference listed in diff.
rules.not_in_script: If the dami returns NOT_IN_SCRIPT, the UI offers BO03 (manual asset) prefilled with the user's text.
rules.rescan: ADR01 re-runs the dami in incremental mode with all current assets as known_assets, so approved assets keep their ids.

technical.label: Something from the script is missing
technical.instruction: Search the script for the asset named in custom_text and add it with evidence, scene_refs and scene_index updates. If it is not in the script, do not add it and return NOT_IN_SCRIPT.

technical.label: These are the same one
technical.instruction: Merge the target assets into one entry, keep the approved or lowest id, merge aliases, facts, looks, states and scene_refs, and update every reference.
technical.ui_note: Select two or more cards of the same category.

technical.label: This is actually two different ones
technical.label_fa: این در واقع دو تا است
technical.instruction: Split the target into two entries using custom_text and the script, assign scenes and evidence to each, and update every reference.
technical.ui_note: Text box optional: 'How are they different?'

technical.label: Wrong category
technical.instruction: Move the target to the category named in custom_text with a new id of that type, rebuild its fields from the script and update every reference.
technical.ui_note: Chips instead of text: character, location, prop. The chip value is sent as custom_text.

technical.label: The description is wrong
technical.instruction: Re-check every fact of the target against the script, remove facts without valid evidence and correct the rest. Use custom_text as a hint.

technical.label: Wrong scenes
technical.instruction: Re-scan the script for the target and rebuild its scene_refs and the scene_index entries.

technical.label: Wrong name or role
technical.instruction: Apply the name or role in custom_text when the script supports it, otherwise re-derive them from the script.

preference.label: I don't need this as a separate asset
preference.instruction: Set asset_priority to 'skipped'. No Claude call. Skipped assets are not designed; the Text Blocks dami describes them inline from script_description.

preference.label: Make this its own asset
preference.instruction: Promote the thing named in custom_text (a fixed element, a background figure, an object) to its own entry with evidence and remove it from where it was recorded before.
preference.ui_note: Text box: 'What should be its own asset?' The user can also start it from a fixed element or background figure on a card.

preference.label: Give this look its own asset
preference.label_fa: این ظاهر یا حالت را جدا بساز
preference.instruction: Turn the target look or state into a separate entry linked with same_person_as or related_asset_ids, and move its scenes.
preference.ui_note: Shown on cards that have looks or states; the user picks one.

preference.label: Group these into one
preference.instruction: Merge the target props into one prop_group entry.

preference.label: Other
preference.instruction: Follow custom_text as far as the script allows. Never invent content that is not in the script.

actions.label: Re-scan the whole script
actions.label_fa: دوباره کل فیلم‌نامه را بررسی کن
actions.instruction: Re-run detection on the full script with all current assets as known_assets.

backend_operations.label: Rename (display only)
backend_operations.effect: Changes name and ui_summary; keeps the old name in aliases. No Claude call.

backend_operations.label: Delete
backend_operations.effect: Removes the asset and its references from scene_index. Approved assets need confirmation.

backend_operations.label: Add manually
backend_operations.effect: Creates an asset with source 'user', the next free id, the user's description as script_description, empty facts and the scenes the user ticks.

backend_operations.label: Edit facts
backend_operations.effect: Pro edits facts directly; edited facts get status 'user' in the stored copy.
